title: Townsend Brown's gravitational anomaly expeditions in Nassau

tellings.quote: Town Towns and Brown also spent a ton of time in the Bahamas. Did you know that? In Nassau specifically, and he would do these expeditions where he'd look at gravitational anomalies there.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that an American inventor named Townsend Brown spent a lot of time in Nassau, the capital of the Bahamas. According to Michels, Brown went on expeditions there to look for gravitational anomalies, meaning places where gravity seems to behave oddly. If true, it would show Brown searching the natural world for clues to his ideas about gravity.
